name: vault-naturalist
description: Field observations and region-scoped phenology for a vault's natural-history wiki: compile every species card's seasonal windows into a queryable index, report what is expected here this month, and record what was actually seen.

tools.name: vault_naturalist
tools.description: Compile the Phenology tables on animal, plant, and fungus wiki cards into a JSON index keyed by species, event, month, and region; report what is expected in a given month in the owner's declared home region; and write a single field observation as a schema-valid note linked to its species card. Deterministic throughout: no model is called and nothing is fetched. compile and report never write to a note.
